warning_source: Yahya Sinwar message via Shin Bet channel with senior Egyptian counterparts; Ronen Bar / Shin Bet
recipient: Benjamin Netanyahu; Prime Minister's Office; Israeli intelligence/security officials
warning_summary: Mid-September intelligence warned of an impending Hamas 'earthquake' / intention to make the ground in Gaza tremble; Bar then briefed Netanyahu and later urged offensive action or stronger defensive preparations.
evidence_update: Israel Hayom (25 Mar 2026) reports the Sinwar message moved through a secret Shin Bet channel involving senior Egyptian officials and reached the intelligence community, PMO and Netanyahu. Army Radio, reported by Times of Israel (9 Sep 2026), independently says Shin Bet presented Netanyahu warnings from Egyptian counterparts that Hamas intended to 'make the ground in Gaza tremble'. This materially strengthens provenance and receipt and was added to WARN-15 in Notion.
gaps: Underlying Shin Bet/Egyptian record and meeting minutes remain unpublished; the reports appear to describe the already accepted mid-September WARN-15 chain rather than a distinct warning event, so no duplicate was created and confidence remains Medium.
